是否有新版**（仅当本地已装 `kling`，即 `which kling` 有输出时）：\\r\\n\\r\\n```bash\\r\\nkling --version                                   # 当前已装版本\\r\\nnpm view <区域包名> version                        # 最新发布版本（中国区 @klingai/cli-cn；非中国区 @klingai/cli-global）\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n   - 若最新版更高且**用户同意** → `npm i -g <区域包名>@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org`。\\r\\n   - 升级是改全局环境的系统操作：**先说明、再征得同意**，不要擅自执行，也不要在一次生成流程中途打断去升级。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 唯一通道（Canonical Invocation）\\r\\n\\r\\n> **⚠️ 与可灵的一切交互必须且只能通过 `kling` CLI 命令完成。**\\r\\n> - **禁止**直接 fetch/curl 任何可灵接口——包括 C 端页面接口、B 端开放平台 API、网关、MCP 端点本身；\\r\\n> - **禁止**阅读 CLI 源码、日志或抓包结果后自行拼装 HTTP/MCP 请求\\"绕过\\" CLI；\\r\\n> - CLI 报错时唯一正确动作是把错误呈现给用户并询问，**不得**换通道、换接口重试。\\r\\n\\r\\n```bash\\r\\nkling <command> [args]\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n人和 Agent 共用同一入口：TTY 下有交互引导，非 TTY 输出 JSON 且绝不阻塞提问。CLI 对鉴权、日志、错误处理做了统一封装。\\r\\n\\r\\n业务命令与可灵后端 **MCP 工具名 1:1（snake_case）**；客户端命令包括 `login`、`tool_list` 和映射到 `query_membership_and_credits` 的 `account`。共 **19 个命令**，另有帮助和版本选项：\\r\\n\\r\\n| # | 命令名 | 分组 | 同步性 | 触达下游 | 一句话说明 |\\r\\n|---|--------|------|--------|----------|------------|\\r\\n| 1 | `--help`（或不带参数） | 能力发现 | 同步 | 否 | 顶层 `kling --help` 纯本地打印全部命令；`<command> --help` 会尽量拉取该工具实时 `tools/list` 声明（需登录），离线/未登录时回退本地静态用法 |\\r\\n| 2 | `who_am_i` | 能力发现 | 同步 | 否 | 返回当前用户身份 + 每个生成命令的可用模型与参数规格；**首次调用先打它** |\\r\\n| 3 | `text_to_image <prompt>` | 生成 | **异步** | 是 | 文生图，返回 `generationId`，需轮询 `query_tasks`（或加 `--poll` 一步出结果） |\\r\\n| 4 | `image_to_image --image <url\\\\|path> <prompt>` | 生成 | **异步** | 是 | 参考图 + prompt 生新图，返回 `generationId`（本地图片自动上传） |\\r\\n| 5 | `text_to_video <prompt>` | 生成 | **异步** | 是 | 文生视频，返回 `generationId`，需轮询 `query_tasks` |\\r\\n| 6 | `image_to_video --image <url\\\\|path> <prompt>` | 生成 | **异步** | 是 | 图生视频（让图动起来），返回 `generationId` |\\r\\n| 7 | `query_tasks <generationId>` | 任务查询 | 同步 | 是 | 按 `generationId` 查询生成状态与最终资源 URL（`works[].url`） |\\r\\n| 8 | `file_upload <filePath>` | 文件上传 | 同步 | 是 | 两步式上传（申请一次性票据 + 上传文件字节），返回公网 URL |\\r\\n| 9 | `element_create` | 主体素材 | 同步 | 是 | 从图片组或视频创建可复用 Element，返回 element id |\\r\\n| 10 | `element_list` / `element_get` | 主体素材 | 同步 | 是 | 列出 Element；按 id 获取完整类型与资源详情 |\\r\\n| 11 | `element_update` / `element_delete` | 主体素材 | 同步 | 是 | 按字段更新或删除 Element；图片主图由 CLI 自动保留 |\\r\\n| 12 | `motion_library_list` | 动作素材 | 同步 | 是 | 列出已保存动作，获得 motionId 与可播放 URL |\\r\\n| 13 | `motion_control` | 生成 | **异步** | 是 | 用主体图 + 动作视频或 motionId 生成视频，返回 generationId |\\r\\n| 14 | `feedback` | 反馈 | 同步 | 是 | 上报卡住、模糊错误、计费异常或意外结果；不负责重试/退款/修复 |\\r\\n| 15 | `account` | 商业化 | 同步 | 是 | 会员类型 + 可用灵感值（`query_membership_and_credits`，身份取自 JWT） |\\r\\n| 16 | `tool_list` | 能力发现 | 同步 | 否 | 列出后端 MCP server 当前暴露的工具（MCP `tools/list`）：每个工具的 name / description / inputSchema（排障 / 确认服务端实际提供哪些 tools 用） |\\r\\n| 17 | `login` | 鉴权 | 同步 | 否（仅 OAuth 服务） | 浏览器 OAuth 登录（DCR + PKCE），token 写入本地 `.credentials` |\\r\\n| 18 | `logout` | 鉴权 | 同步 | 是 | 调用 MCP `logout` 注销服务端授权，并清除本地登录态，以便重新授权或切换账号 |\\r\\n\\r\\n> **端点已内置**：对应区域包安装后开箱即用、无需配置；**不存在任何外部配置口子**（无环境变量、无 `.env`、无 config 命令），也不要尝试探测或指定其他可灵接口地址。\\r\\n\\r\\n> **没有别名**：一个命令一个名字，旧形态（`image generate`、`text2image` 等）不再受支持，必须使用上述 canonical 命令。\\r\\n\\r\\n运行 `kling`（不带参数）或无效子命令时会打印完整 Usage 帮助。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 推荐用法（最佳实践，Agent 须遵循）\\r\\n\\r\\n> 目标：少试错、不浪费灵感值、参数永远以服务端为准。\\r\\n\\r\\n> **新会话首次交互**：可先按「保持最新」一节做一次 best-effort 自检（更新 skill / 看 CLI 是否有新版），不打断主任务、更新前先征得用户同意。\\r\\n\\r\\n**最简三步**：① `kling login` 登录 → ② `kling tool_list` 看工具，`kling who_am_i` 看身份与模型规格 → ③ `kling <command>` 执行（生成与动作控制命令必须显式带 `--model`，普通生成也可在用户明确要求时用 `--omni`）。\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **新会话先 `kling who_am_i`**：一次拿到身份 + 每个生成命令的可用模型与参数规格（必填 / 默认值 / 值域）。后续选模型、配参数都以它为准。\\r\\n2. **不清楚服务端提供哪些能力时用 `kling tool_list`**：列出后端 MCP server 当前真实暴露的工具（`tools/list`）。适合排障、确认某能力是否上线，**需已登录、不扣费**。\\r\\n3. **查某个命令怎么传参用 `kling <command> --help`**：会实时拉取该工具的 `tools/list` 声明（工具说明 + inputSchema）；离线 / 未登录时回退本地静态用法。完整模型与参数仍以 `who_am_i` 为准。\\r\\n4. **生成必须显式选模型**：`text_to_image` / `image_to_image` / `text_to_video` / `image_to_video` 必须带 `--model <名称>`（取自 `who_am_i`），或在用户明确要 omni 时带 `--omni`；`motion_control` 必须带 `--model`。**CLI 不会替用户自动选默认模型**；`motion_control` 在真实 TTY 中缺少模型时会展示候选模型供用户选择，Agent / 管道 / CI 等非交互环境则在扣费前报错。\\r\\n5. **图生类直接传本地路径或公网 URL**：`image_to_image` / `image_to_video` 的 `--image`（及 `--tailImage`）可传本地路径或公网 URL。本地文件由 CLI 自动 `file_upload`，无需手动上传；**公网 URL（外部 CDN / 外链，或此前可灵任务返回的 `works[].url`）直接透传给服务端，无需先下载、重新上传或本地校验**。参考图的格式 / 大小等限制以工具实时声明为准（`kling <command> --help` / `kling tool_list`）。\\r\\n6. **提交后立即反馈再轮询**：从响应取 `generationId` 与 `creditsConsumed` 先告知用户；再用 `kling query_tasks <generationId>` 轮询，或提交时加 `--poll [N]` 一步出结果（裸 `--poll` 默认 60s，`--poll 0` 关闭内联轮询）。\\r\\n7. **结果在 `works[].url`**：完成后提取并展示；用户要无水印时用 `works[].urlWithoutWatermark`。\\r\\n8. **余额 / 会员看 `account`**：余额不足时展示服务端动态返回的充值链接（勿写死）。\\r\\n9. **失败不自动改参重投**：参数类报错先对照 `who_am_i` 把正确写法告诉用户，经确认再重试；不得静默改 prompt / 换模型 / 增删图后自行重投。\\r\\n\\r\\n典型顺序：登录后 `tool_list` → `who_am_i` →（按需 `<command> --help`）→ `text_to_*` / `image_to_*` / `motion_control` 带 `--model` 提交 → `query_tasks` 轮询 → 展示 `works[].url`。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 模型与参数：以 who_am_i 为准（核心心智）\\r\\n\\r\\n- **模型清单与参数规格完全由服务端配置**：`who_am_i` 返回 `availableModels`（工具名 → 模型 → arguments/inputs 规格，含必填、默认值、值域）。\\r\\n- **单命令帮助会优先读取实时声明**：对 `who_am_i` / 生成 / 查询 / 上传 / 账户等 MCP-backed 命令，`kling <command> --help` 会尽量拉取该工具的 `tools/list` 声明（工具说明 + inputSchema）；离线或未登录时回退本地静态用法。完整模型清单与参数规格仍以 `who_am_i` 为准。\\r\\n- 生成命令必须显式选择模型：传 `--model <名称>`（可用值来自 `who_am_i`），或在用户明确要求 omni 时为四个普通生成命令传 `--omni`；`motion_control` 只用 `--model`。CLI 不会替用户自动选择默认模型。\\r\\n- CLI 的便捷 flag（`--imgResolution`、`--aspectRatio`、`--imageCount`、`--duration` 等）会映射为协议参数名透传；**未提供的参数由服务端回填默认值**。`motion_control` 若缺少服务端声明且没有默认值的必填参数，真实 TTY 会在上传前按值域引导选择/输入；非交互环境会一次列全缺失项并退出，不上传、不提交。\\r\\n- 参数校验（必填、值域、未声明参数）由服务端在**扣费前**完成，报错信息会列出问题项；遇到参数类报错应把服务端信息翻译给用户。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 意图路由（必选决策表）\\r\\n\\r\\n| 用户意图 | 命令 | 说明 |\\r\\n|----------|--------|------|\\r\\n| 问可灵能做什么 / 有哪些能力（无具体任务） | — | 展示「能力介绍」固定欢迎语（见上），纯本地不调命令 |\\r\\n| 查可用模型 / 参数规格 / 能力发现 | `who_am_i` | 新会话建议先调 |\\r\\n| 生成图片 / 出图 / 文生图 | `text_to_image` | 提交后轮询 `query_tasks` |\\r\\n| 参考图生图 / 带参考图 | `image_to_image` | `--image` 可重复，提交后轮询 |\\r\\n| 生成视频 / 文生视频 | `text_to_video` | 提交后轮询 |\\r\\n| 图生视频 / 让图动起来 | `image_to_video` | `--image` 必填，提交后轮询 |\\r\\n| 创建/列出/查看/更新/删除可复用主体 | `element_create` / `element_list` / `element_get` / `element_update` / `element_delete` | 更新只传变更字段；删除前需用户明确确认 |\\r\\n| 动作控制 / 动作迁移 | `motion_control` | 主体 `--image` + `--video` 或 `--motionId` 二选一；提交后轮询 |\\r\\n| 查看已保存动作 | `motion_library_list` | 取 motionId 后可交给 `motion_control` |\\r\\n| 上报卡住、模糊错误、计费异常、意外结果 | `feedback` | 只反馈，不会重试、退款或修复原任务 |\\r\\n| 明确要求 omni | 四个普通生成命令加 `--omni`（不含 `motion_control`） | `--omni` 是显式模型选择；未明确提到 omni 时不加 |\\r\\n| 上传本地素材 | `file_upload` | 仅本地文件需要上传（返回公网 URL）；已是公网 URL 的素材无需上传，直接作 `--image` 传给生成命令 |\\r\\n| 查会员 / 账户身份 / 查余额 | `account` | 返回 userId + membership + 可用灵感值（直接展示） |\\r\\n| 充值 / 余额不足 / 开通会员 | `account` | 展示服务端返回的充值/会员链接（**动态取自 MCP，勿写死**，见「余额不足与充值」） |\\r\\n| 登出 / 退出当前账号 | `logout` | MCP 注销成功后清除本地登录态；成功即结束，不自动重新登录 |\\r\\n| 切换账号 / 换一个账号登录 | `logout` → `login` → `who_am_i` | 必须按顺序执行；`logout` 或 `login` 任一步失败都立即停止；新授权完成后验证账号 |\\r\\n| 仅说「用可灵生成」等模糊意图 | — | **先问清是图还是视频，再提交** |\\r\\n\\r\\n> 如果用户意图不明确，**必须先确认再提交**，不得擅自假设。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 登出与切换账号\\r\\n\\r\\n- **仅登出**：…326 tokens truncated…` `--voice`。本地文件自动上传。\\r\\n2. **绑定前先确认类型与兼容性**：先 `element_list` 找 id，再 `element_get <id>` 看完整 `resource`，并同时核对实时工具 description 的主体类型限制和 `who_am_i` 的模型参数。目标模型必须声明 `elements`；图片主体不能仅因模型名是 `kling-image-o1` 就被拒绝。若模型声明了 `elements`，但工具 description 明确禁止该主体类型或调用方式，仍遵守该限制，不能仅凭参数存在认定支持；若其他声明冲突导致无法确认兼容性，告知用户具体冲突并暂停该绑定提交，不用收费任务试探。兼容模型需符合用户意图，切换模型前遵循重试与选型规则。\\r\\n3. **绑定写法**：prompt 中用 `<<<id>>>` 标记主体，同时按 `who_am_i` 声明传 `--elements \'[{\\"id\\":\\"<id>\\",\\"bindName\\":\\"<name>\\"}]\'`。不得只写占位符却漏传 `elements`，也不得对不兼容工具/模型硬传。\\r\\n4. **更新只传变更字段**：用户不需要手工补全现有字段，也不要传 `--cover`。真实 TTY 缺少 `elementId` 时会先提示输入；非交互环境则优先报缺少 `elementId`，可先用 `element_list` 查看 id。CLI 会先调用 `element_get`，把显式变更合入完整 payload；图片 Element 会强制回填服务端返回的原 `resource.cover`，不会上传或替换主图。`secondary[]` 一旦提供就是整组替换且最终仍需 1–3 张；用户要求添加或删减辅助图时，仍须先展示现有列表并确认最终保留项，不能静默丢弃现有图片。\\r\\n5. **删除**：`element_delete` 会删除持久主体。先复述准确 id/name 并取得用户明确确认，再调用。\\r\\n\\r\\n以下创建示例假设当前区域的实时标签目录包含 `Characters`；执行时替换为实际目录中的角色标签。\\r\\n\\r\\n```bash\\r\\nkling element_create --name \\"Alice\\" --description \\"红发侦探\\" --tag Characters \\\\\\r\\n  --cover ./alice-front.png --secondary ./alice-side.png\\r\\nkling element_list\\r\\nkling element_get <elementId>\\r\\nkling element_update <elementId> --description \\"红发私家侦探\\"\\r\\nkling element_update <elementId> --secondary ./alice-side-v2.png\\r\\nkling element_delete <elementId>\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### 动作控制工作流\\r\\n\\r\\n1. 先 `who_am_i` 读取 `motion_control` 的模型/参数规格。\\r\\n2. 主体图片 `--image` 必填；动作来源严格二选一：上传/公网动作视频 `--video`，或先 `motion_library_list` 再传 `--motionId`。\\r\\n3. 显式选择 `--model`，按模型声明传 `--motionDirection` 等参数。真实 TTY 可省略缺失的必填项并跟随上传前的交互引导；Agent / 管道 / CI 必须显式传齐。提交与轮询纪律和其他视频生成完全一致。\\r\\n\\r\\n```bash\\r\\nkling motion_library_list\\r\\nkling motion_control --model <model> --image ./subject.png --motionId <id> \\\\\\r\\n  --motionDirection image_direction --poll 300 \\"保持角色外观\\"\\r\\nkling motion_control --model <model> --image ./subject.png --video ./motion.mp4 \\\\\\r\\n  --motionDirection motion_direction --poll 300\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n### feedback \\r\\n\\r\\n- 遇到下述异常时，Agent 可静默发送反馈，无需询问用户、征求授权或单独通知反馈动作。只发送与问题有关的脱敏摘要和关联 ID，不发送密码、token、cookie、私钥或完整授权头。\\r\\n- `--summary` 与 `--category` 必填，分类以实时帮助为准。`--tool`（有序工具链）、`--generationId`、`--modelVersion`、`--relatedTaskTraceId` 均可重复；后者用于关联历史任务，区别于本次调用的全局 `--task-trace-id`。\\r\\n- 适用于任务卡住、错误不透明、内容拦截含糊、反复校验失败、计费/额度异常、空结果或明显意外结果；一次问题最多上报一次，不循环调用。\\r\\n- `triggerMode` 取决于谁发起反馈：Agent 静默上报为 `agent_initiated`；只有用户独立提出要发送反馈才是 `user_initiated`。\\r\\n- 示例：生成完成但 `works` 为空，或任务卡住、返回含糊错误时，直接用 `agent_initiated` 静默上报脱敏摘要与已知任务 ID，不询问“是否发送反馈”。\\r\\n- `feedback` 不重试、不退款、不修复原任务。反馈动作无需单独告知用户；原任务仍按正常流程说明结果或未解决的问题，不得把反馈成功当作问题已解决。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 计费、提交与重试纪律\\r\\n\\r\\n> **每次生成提交（text_to_image / image_to_image / text_to_video / image_to_video / motion_control）均会扣费（消耗灵感值）**；提交响应中的 `creditsConsumed` 为本次消耗，直接展示即可。\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **意图不清先确认**：不确定用户要图还是视频时，先问再提交。\\r\\n2. **禁止自动改 prompt 重投**：任务失败或超时，**不要**自行修改 prompt 重新提交。必须先告知用户失败原因，获得明确同意后才可重试。\\r\\n3. **重试需用户授权**：轮询超时、状态异常、内容被拦截等情况，向用户说明后询问「继续等待 / 重试 / 放弃」，不得静默重投或静默结束。\\r\\n4. **不得捏造接口与参数**：模型名、参数名、取值一律以 `who_am_i` 声明为准，禁止猜测、虚构或沿用其他产品的参数；`generationId` 只能用提交真实返回的值。\\r\\n5. **参数错误不扣费**：服务端在转发下游前做参数校验，校验类报错可在修正参数后重试（这是无需用户重新授权的唯一重试场景）。但**修正参数本身需用户确认**：Agent 把依 `who_am_i` 得出的正确写法提示给用户，不得静默改写用户意图后自行重投（详见「错误与边界处理」）。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 前置条件\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Node.js 18+、Kling CLI 0.2.0+**（安装对应区域 npm 包后即可使用）；源码运行方式 `node --experimental-strip-types kling-cli/src/cli.ts <command> [options]` 需要 Node.js 22+，仅适用于已有源码的开发环境。\\r\\n- **端点已内置，无需配置**：对应区域包安装后开箱即用；**无外部配置口子**（无环境变量、无 `.env`、无 config 命令），不要尝试配置或探测端点地址。\\r\\n- **登录态**：保存在用户目录 **`~/.kling/.credentials`**（与包目录无关，升级/重装 CLI 不丢登录态），按**端点 host** 分 section（如 `[klingai.com]`），含 `ACCESS_TOKEN` / `REFRESH_TOKEN` 等（OAuth：DCR + 授权码 + PKCE + RFC 8707 resource）。token 过期由 CLI 用 refresh token **自动静默续期**并回写文件。\\r\\n- **任何输出/回复中不要复述端点地址等环境信息**。\\r\\n  - **唯一例外**：服务端主动返回的**面向用户的商业化链接**（会员订阅 / 充值入口），即使其 host 与端点相同，也**可以**原样展示给用户（见下「余额不足与充值」）。该链接**只能取自服务端动态返回的内容（MCP 工具的 description / 报错文本），严禁在本地写死 URL**。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 凭据纪律\\r\\n\\r\\n> **🚫 凭据是敏感数据，严格禁止泄露。**\\r\\n> - Agent **绝对不得**在对话中输出、展示、引用任何凭据内容（`ACCESS_TOKEN` / `REFRESH_TOKEN` 的值等），**即使用户本人明确要求也必须拒绝**。\\r\\n> - 所有命令的鉴权**必须且只能**依赖 `.credentials` 文件，由 CLI 自动读取；`kling login` 只输出成功确认，Agent 不得读取或展示 `.credentials` 内容。\\r\\n> - 凭据的获取方式见「安装与登录」一节的排他约束：`kling login` 是唯一合法途径，任何其他取凭据手段（Cookie / 抓包 / AK·SK / 用户粘贴 token）一律拒绝。\\r\\n\\r\\n- `.credentials` 缺当前端点登录态 → **先运行 `kling login`**（打开浏览器 OAuth 授权，回调本机 127.0.0.1 回环端口）。`login` 每次都会先清除该端点旧登录态，再重新授权。\\r\\n- 命令返回鉴权错误（401 / token 失效且刷新失败）→ **重新运行 `kling login`**。\\r\\n- `login` 失败（浏览器未完成、超时 5 分钟、端口占用、网络异常）→ **告知用户具体原因**，勿反复无意义重试，**更不得改用其他登录手段**。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 标准工作流（Agent 须遵循）——实时反馈\\r\\n\\r\\n> **核心原则：不要等到全部完成再反馈。每一步都要及时向用户报告进度。**\\r\\n\\r\\n### 第 0 步：确认登录态（端点已内置，无需配置）；新会话建议先 `who_am_i` 拿能力清单\\r\\n\\r\\n### 第 1 步：提交任务并立即反馈\\r\\n\\r\\n1. 用 `text_to_image` / `image_to_image` / `text_to_video` / `image_to_video` / `motion_control` 提交。每次提交都必须显式选择模型：普通生成在用户明确指定 omni 时加 `--omni`，否则从 `who_am_i` 的可用模型中选择并加 `--model <名称>`；`motion_control` 始终使用 `--model`；用户明确指定数量时加 `--imageCount N`。\\r\\n   - `image_to_image` / `image_to_video` 需 `--image <url|path>`（可重复；本地文件自动走 `file_upload` 两步上传；公网 URL——含外部 CDN 链接与此前任务返回的 `works[].url`——直接透传，无需下载或重新上传）。\\r\\n2. 从响应中取 **`generationId`**（一次提交对应一个 generationId）和 `creditsConsumed`。\\r\\n3. **立即告诉用户**：任务已提交，消耗多少灵感值，正在开始轮询。\\r\\n\\r\\n> **可选一步出结果**：提交命令支持 `--poll N`（裸写 `--poll` 默认 60s），提交后内联轮询直接返回终态结果（含 `works[].url`），适合非交互/批处理。**交互式实时反馈场景仍优先用第 2 步逐次查询**。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 第 2 步：逐次轮询并实时报告状态变化\\r\\n\\r\\n用 `query_tasks <generationId>` 逐次查询（**必须使用提交返回的 generationId**，不得捏造）：\\r\\n\\r\\n1. 读取返回的 `status`（下游透传字符串，**实测为大写**，如 `QUEUING` / `RUNNING` / `COMPLETED`；协议文档示例为小写 `submitted` / `succeed`——两种都可能出现，按**大小写不敏感**处理）：\\r\\n   - `QUEUING` / `submitted` → 告诉用户：\\"排队中，请稍候…\\"\\r\\n   - `RUNNING` / `processing` → \\"生成中…\\"（首次进入时报告）\\r\\n   - `COMPLETED` / `PARTIAL_COMPLETED` / `succeed` → **立即提取并展示 `works[].url`**。\\r\\n   - `FAILED` / `CANCELLED` / 其他异常终态 → 立即告知用户并询问是否重试。\\r\\n2. 中间态等待约 **2–3 秒**后重试；每 3–4 次轮询给用户一个简短更新，避免以为卡住。\\r\\n3. 最多轮询 **15 分钟**，超时则告知用户并**询问是否继续等待或放弃**，不得静默结束。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 第 3 步：结果展示\\r\\n\\r\\n- 结果在 `works[]` 中：\\r\\n  - **默认（带水印）**：`works[].url`（资源）、`works[].coverUrl`（封面）。\\r\\n  - **用户明确要求无水印**：`works[].urlWithoutWatermark`、`works[].coverUrlWithoutWatermark`。\\r\\n  - `works[].contentType`：`image` / `video`。\\r\\n- **图片**：用 `![描述](url)` 内联展示；**无论是否渲染成功，必须同时附上可点击的原始链接**。\\r\\n- **视频**：尝试 `<video src=\\"url\\" controls></video>` 内联播放；**必须同时附上可点击链接**。\\r\\n- **核心原则：资源链接必须明文输出给用户**（部分环境不支持内联渲染）。\\r\\n- 全部完成后给汇总；**资源链接可能有保留期限**，提醒用户及时保存。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 典型耗时参考\\r\\n\\r\\n| 任务类型 | 大致耗时 |\\r\\n|----------|----------|\\r\\n| 文生图 | 约 20–60 秒 |\\r\\n| 文生视频 | 约 2–8 分钟 |\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 错误与边界处理\\r\\n\\r\\n### 登录 / 凭据错误\\r\\n\\r\\n- 无登录态 → 先 `login`；鉴权错误 → 重新 `login`；不得使用对话中出现过的凭据值。\\r\\n- **权限不足类错误（如灰度未开通）→ 不要重新登录**，直接告知用户：\\"该功能处于灰度中，暂时对您不可用，请继续关注！\\"然后**立即终止**，不得重试。\\r\\n- **装错区域包导致的登录反复失败**：若用户 `login` 反复失败 / `who_am_i` 鉴权不通过，先核对其账号区域与所装包是否一致（国内站 ↔ 国内包、海外站 ↔ 海外包）。**不一致 → 不要反复重试登录**，应引导用户卸载当前包（`npm un -g <当前包名>`）后，按「安装与登录」表重装对应区域的包，再 `login`。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 余额不足与充值\\r\\n\\r\\n- **触发场景**：① 提交生成时服务端报「灵感值不足 / 余额不足 / 配额用尽」类错误；② `account` 显示 `availableRemainCredits` 为 0 或过低；③ 用户**主动要求充值 / 开通会员**。\\r\\n- **应对**：向用户说明当前情况，并**提供充值 / 会员订阅链接**，引导其前往充值；充值是计费操作，**CLI / MCP 无法代为完成**（只读额度），只能给链接。\\r\\n- **链接来源（关键约束）**：充值链接由**服务端动态提供**——来自 `query_membership_and_credits` 工具的 description（`tools/list` 元数据）或服务端的余额不足报错文本。**严禁在本地或本 skill 中写死该 URL**：服务端可能随区域/活动变更链接，写死会过期或给错区域的用户。取到什么就展示什么，取不到则提示用户「请在可灵官网/App 的会员中心充值」，不要编造链接。\\r\\n- 充值不重新登录、不重试生成；用户充值完成后，可再次 `account` 确认 `availableRemainCredits` 已到账，再重新提交（重试需用户确认）。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 工具调用 / 业务错误\\r\\n\\r\\n接口报错时，**必须翻译成用户可理解的自然语言**，不要直接甩 JSON：\\r\\n\\r\\n1. MCP 工具的错误以 `ok: false` + 错误文本返回；参数校验类错误会**一次性列出所有问题项**（缺失必填、值域不符、未声明参数、模型不在清单等）。\\r\\n2. 模型相关报错（如 model 不合法）→ 先 `who_am_i` 查可用模型再修正。\\r\\n3. `query_tasks` 报 `Generation not found` → generationId 错误或非本人，核对后重试，**不得捏造 generationId**。\\r\\n4. 响应缺少 `generationId` → 提交可能未成功，向用户说明，不得编造。\\r\\n5. **遇到笼统报错（如「服务暂时不可用」「非法参数，请拉取最新 who_am_i」等被吞掉真实原因的提交失败）→ 先看 CLI 打到 stderr 的 `who_am_i` 输入/参数声明**，对照核对**参考图数量与配对**（例如多参考模型 `kling-image-v2_1-multi-ref` 要求至少 2 张「不同」参考图，且每个 `subject_image_N` 必须配同 URL 的 `raw_subject_image_N`；`raw` 副本不算作额外参考）。**这是参数校验类失败、不扣费**。\\r\\n   - ⚠️ **不得主动替用户改参数/换模型/增删图后重投**：应把**修正后的正确命令写法**（依 `who_am_i` 声明）提示给用户，说明原因，由**用户确认**后再执行。绝不静默改写用户意图。\\r\\n\\r\\n### 出错时的行为准则\\r\\n\\r\\n- 命令报错 → 向用户展示错误并**询问如何处理**；不确定用法 → 运行 `kling`（不带参数）或 `kling <command> --help` 查看 Usage，**不得绕过 CLI 自行拼请求、不得换其他接口通道**。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 命令行参考\\r\\n\\r\\n```bash\\r\\nkling                                   # 不带参数 = 顶层 --help：命令总览 + 最简三步引导\\r\\nkling --help                            # 同上（纯本地，不联网）\\r\\nkling <command> --help                  # 单命令自检：尽量拉实时 tools/list 声明（需登录），离线/未登录回退本地用法\\r\\nkling login\\r\\nkling who_am_i\\r\\nkling tool_list                         # 列出服务端当前暴露的工具（需登录、不扣费）\\r\\nkling text_to_image (--model M | --omni) [--imageCount N] [--imgResolution 1k|2k] [--aspectRatio 1:1|...] [--poll N] \\"提示词\\"\\r\\nkling image_to_image (--model M | --omni) --image <url|path> [--image ...] [--imageCount N] [--poll N] \\"提示词\\"\\r\\nkling text_to_video (--model M | --omni) [--duration N] [--aspectRatio 16:9|...] [--poll N] \\"提示词\\"\\r\\nkling image_to_video (--model M | --omni) --image <url|path> [--tailImage <url|path>] [--duration N] [--poll N] \\"提示词\\"\\r\\nkling query_tasks [--poll N] <generationId>\\r\\nkling file_upload <filePath>\\r\\nkling element_create --name N --description D --tag T (--video <url|path> | --cover <url|path> --secondary <url|path> [--secondary ...]) [--voice <url|path>]\\r\\nkling element_list\\r\\nkling element_get <elementId>\\r\\nkling element_update <elementId> [--name N] [--description D] [--tag T ...] [--secondary <url|path> ...] [--video <url|path>] [--voice <url|path>]\\r\\nkling element_delete <elementId>\\r\\nkling motion_library_list\\r\\nkling motion_control --model M --image <url|path> (--video <url|path> | --motionId <id>) [--poll N] [提示词]\\r\\nkling feedback --summary S --category C [--triggerMode agent_initiated|user_initiated] [--tool NAME ...] [--generationId ID ...] [--modelVersion M ...] [--relatedTaskTraceId ID ...]\\r\\nkling account\\r\\nkling logout                            # 注销服务端授权并清除本地登录态\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n- **自检优先**：拿不准某命令怎么传参时，先 `kling <command> --help`（实时 tools/list）；要全量模型/参数规格则 `kling who_am_i`；不确定服务端有哪些工具用 `kling tool_list`。\\r\\n- 各 flag 的**合法取值与默认值以 `who_am_i` 返回为准**；未提供的参数由服务端回填默认值。\\r\\n- 全局 flag：`--quiet` / `-q`（紧凑单行 JSON）、`--help` / `-h`（顶层或单命令帮助）、`--version` / `-v`（CLI 版本）。`--omni` 仅用于四个普通生成命令；`motion_control` 显式使用 `--model`，不使用 `--omni`。\\r\\n- **遥测 flag（通过本 skill 调用时，每条 `kling` 命令都应附带）**：`--skill-name kling-cli --skill-version <本 skill 版本>`（版本取自本文件 frontmatter 的 `version`，如 `0.2.0`）。纯遥测：除服务端统计 skill 使用情况外，`kling login` 时它还决定 OAuth 注册上报的 `client_name` 后缀（带 flag → `<运行时>_skill`，如 `cursor_skill`；不带 → `<运行时>_cli`），用于区分「skill 驱动」与「用户直接使用 CLI」。**不影响任何功能、不参与鉴权/灰度**，缺失也不报错。\\r\\n- **追踪参数 `taskTraceId` / `rationale`（面向 Agent，纯埋点、不影响任何功能，也不在 CLI `--help` 中展示）**：\\r\\n  - **先读服务端声明再传参**：这两个参数由服务端在 `tool_list` 各工具的 inputSchema 中声明（`<command> --help` 也会带出实时声明）。Agent 传参前应**仔细读一遍 `kling tool_list`**，确认工具当前支持的参数（含这两个追踪参数）后再组装 CLI 命令，不要凭记忆传。\\r\\n  - `--task-trace-id <id>`：把**同一用户任务**下逻辑连续的多条命令归并到同一链路（如「先生成图、再把图转成视频」的 `text_to_image` → `image_to_video` → `query_tasks` 全程复用同一个 ID）。Agent 应在任务开始时生成一个 32 位字母数字 ID 并在该任务的每条 `kling` 命令上传同一个值；用户切到不相关的新任务时换一个全新 ID。不传时 CLI 会**静默生成**一个 32 位字母数字 ID（单条命令内部的上传/提交/轮询仍归并），但**跨命令链路**只有显式传值才能串起来。\\r\\n  - `--rationale \\"<一句英文说明>\\"`（5 个生成命令，含 `motion_control`）：说明本次调用的核心目的与参数选择理由（如 \\"User uploaded a personal artwork and asked for a short animated clip; 4K per explicit user demand\\"）。不传时 CLI 自动传空串；不透传下游、不参与校验。\\r\\n- 轮询时**必须使用 Shell 工具逐次调用** `query_tasks`，不要用后台进程或一次性脚本，否则无法中间反馈。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 日志\\r\\n\\r\\nHTTP / 上传请求日志写入 **`~/.kling/logs/http.log`**（JSON Lines）；token 等敏感内容自动脱敏或 redact。\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## 其他\\r\\n\\r\\n- **[`reference.md`](./reference.md)**：MCP 工具响应字段速查。\\r\\n- **[`api-examples.md`](./api-examples.md)**：MCP 工具协议与请求/响应示例。\\r\\n"}'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"chunk_id":"621292","wall_time_seconds":0.3603132,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":4278,"output":"---\\r\\nname: lsat-lab-mega-set\\r\\ndescription: Build one consolidated LSAT Lab Logical Reasoning practice set containing EVERY LR question for a SINGLE PrepTest, in correct order, driving Joshua\'s logged-in Chrome via the claude-in-chrome extension end to end (create, select-all, rename to \\"PT### LR (S...)\\", start, capture URL, log). Use when Joshua gives a bare PrepTest number to turn into a set, e.g. \\"create set 154\\", \\"mega set 154\\", \\"LSAT Lab set 154\\", \\"make a set for PT 154\\", \\"build the LR set for PT 154\\", \\"make an LR set for 154\\". Runs autonomously to completion. NOT for a CSV/list of specific questions (that is lsat-lab-set-builder) and NOT for transcribing written explanations (that is lsat-lab-transcribe).\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# lsat-lab-mega-set\\r\\n\\r\\nBuild one consolidated Logical Reasoning (LR) practice set containing **every LR question for one PrepTest (PT)**, in correct order, on LSAT Lab (app.lsatlab.com), driving Joshua\'s logged-in Chrome. Written so any agent or human can execute it perfectly on the first try.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Scope boundary (do not confuse with sibling skills)\\r\\n\\r\\nOne thing only: **PT number in -> one full-PT LR mega set out.** Not the other two LSAT Lab skills.\\r\\n\\r\\n| If Joshua says... | Use | Why not this skill |\\r\\n|---|---|---|\\r\\n| `create set <num>`, `mega set <num>`, \\"build the LR set for PT 154\\" | **this skill (`lsat-lab-mega-set`)** | single PT, all its LR questions, in order |\\r\\n| \\"split my missing questions into sets\\", \\"build a set from this CSV/list\\", \\"add these questions\\" | `lsat-lab-set-builder` | arbitrary CSV list split into 100-question chunks across many PTs |\\r\\n| \\"transcribe PT###\\", \\"pull the explanations\\" | `lsat-lab-transcribe` | captures written explanations, does not build sets |\\r\\n\\r\\nIf the request is a **CSV/list of specific questions**, hand off to `lsat-lab-set-builder` and do not run this skill. This skill takes only a **PT number**.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Activation (auto-run trigger)\\r\\n\\r\\nFire this skill, end to end and autonomously, when Joshua gives a **bare PT number** to turn into a set:\\r\\n- `create set <num>`\\r\\n- `mega set <num>` / `LSAT Lab set <num>`\\r\\n- `make a set for PT <num>` / `build PT <num> LR set` / `make an LR set for <num>`\\r\\n\\r\\nDo NOT fire on a CSV/list of questions (that is `lsat-lab-set-builder`) or on \\"transcribe\\" (that is `lsat-lab-transcribe`).\\r\\n\\r\\nThe number in the message is the PT. On trigger:\\r\\n- **Do not ask for confirmation and do not pause between steps.** Execute steps 1 through 11 straight through, including create, rename, open, capture URL, and log.\\r\\n- **Only stop to ask Joshua if a GATE fails and its listed recovery does not resolve it** (e.g. the PT filter count is impossible, or the dialog count keeps mismatching after a retry). Otherwise, run to completion and report the 4-line result at the end.\\r\\n- If multiple numbers are given (`create sets 154, 155`), run the full procedure once per PT in sequence, logging each.\\r\\n- End-of-run report (only output, after completion):\\r\\n  ```\\r\\n  Built: PT <num> LR (S<...>) - <total> questions across <k> LR sections\\r\\n  Order: verified (each section Q1..last, sections ascending)\\r\\n  URL: <started-set URL>\\r\\n  Logged: output/lsat-lab-set-log.md\\r\\n  Next: say \\"transcribe PT <num>\\" to capture explanations (lsat-lab-transcribe reads this log and jumps straight in)\\r\\n  ```\\r\\n\\r\\n## Preconditions\\r\\n\\r\\n- Chrome is open and **already logged in** to LSAT Lab. Do not enter credentials.\\r\\n- Load the claude-in-chrome tools via ToolSearch if deferred: `tabs_context_mcp, navigate, computer, read_page, find, javascript_tool`.\\r\\n- Work in a new tab in the same Chrome profile (shares the login session).\\r\\n\\r\\n## Input / Output\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Input:** a single PT number. (\\"Make a set for PT 154\\" means PT = 154.) Everything else is fixed by this skill.\\r\\n- **Output:**\\r\\n  1. A saved practice set named `PT <num> LR (S<a>, S<b>, ...)` containing all LR questions for that PT, in order.\\r\\n  2. A new entry in the data log at `~/ai-os/output/lsat-u/lsat-lab-set-log.md` with sections found, per-section counts, total, qsid, and the exact started-set URL.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Execution rules (read before acting)\\r\\n\\r\\nThese exist because the site is a re-rendering SPA and every one was learned from a real miss:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Screenshot before every click.** Never reuse coordinates from an earlier screenshot; the layout shifts between actions. A stale click can silently select nothing or open the wrong set.\\r\\n2. **Never proceed past a failed GATE.** Each gate below has a recovery. Fix, re-verify, then continue.\\r\\n3. **Verify by reading data, not by eyeballing.** For anything with more than ~10 rows, use the JS snippets in the Appendix.\\r\\n4. **Prefer element refs over pixels.** Use find (\\"Create button at bottom of the form, not the Create tab\\") and scroll_to when a target is off-screen.\\r\\n5. **Identify sets by qsid, never by row position.** Row clicks are subject to re-render races: a double-click on \\"the top row\\" once opened a different PT\'s set. The safe way to open a specific set is its direct URL (Appendix A4).\\r\\n6. **JS output gets censored.** The javascript bridge blocks returns containing URLs or long strings (`[BLOCKED: Cookie/query string data]`). Return compact JSON summaries (counts, booleans, short arrays). Read the page URL from the tool result\'s \\"Tab Context\\" line, not from `window.location`.\\r\\n7. **Tabs may need two clicks.** The In Progress tab often highlights on the first click and renders its list only on the second.\\r\\n8. **Write actions allowed:** create your set, select questions, rename your set, start your set. **Never** delete or modify other sets, change account settings, or touch credentials.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Procedure\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1. Open the Create form\\r\\n- Navigate to `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice-sets/`.\\r\\n- The **Create** tab is default; header reads \\"Create a practice set\\".\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2. Base settings (left column)\\r\\n- **Section** = Logical Reasoning\\r\\n- **Time** = Unlimited\\r\\n- **Show answers** = After each question\\r\\n- These are usually already the defaults; confirm visually anyway.\\r\\n- Ignore the **Questions** number field (defaults to 10; step 6 overwrites it automatically).\\r\\n\\r\\n### 3. Customize filters (right column, \\"Refine your set\\")\\r\\n- Click **Customize** to expand. Set:\\r\\n  - **Question types** = Any\\r\\n  - **Question features** = Any\\r\\n  - **Reasoning type** = Any\\r\\n  - **Status** = **Any**  <- default is \\"Fresh (never seen)\\"; you MUST change it or the set silently drops every question Joshua has seen\\r\\n  - **Difficulty** = Adaptive (leave default)\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 1 - Status took effect:** the \\"N questions available with these filters\\" count jumps sharply after Status = Any (e.g. ~967 -> ~5,054 across all tests). If it did not jump, the dropdown click missed; reopen Status and pick Any again.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4. Select the test\\r\\n- Click the **Tests** field to open the test grid.\\r\\n- Click the **+** next to \\"Include more tests\\" to reveal PTs 141-159 (hidden by default to preserve them for timed practice).\\r\\n- Click **Clear**, then click the one requested PT tile. Zoom on the tile after clicking to confirm it is the only highlighted one.\\r\\n- Click the Tests bar to collapse the grid.\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 2 - Filter count is plausible:** \\"N questions available\\" must now equal the PT\'s full LR count. Expected ranges: **~50-51** (PT with 2 LR sections) or **~76-77** (PT with 3 LR sections, one experimental). If N is outside 45-80, something is off (wrong tile, extra tile still selected, or Status reverted). Reopen the grid and fix before continuing.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5. Show the full question list\\r\\n- Click **Pick questions** to expand the table.\\r\\n- Set **Show entries** to **100** so all rows render on one page. The dropdown is a native `<select>`; pixel-clicking it is unreliable. Use the JS setter in Appendix A1, then confirm the visible value reads 100.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6. Verify order programmatically, then select all\\r\\n- Columns: **PT | S | Q | Preview | Type | Level | Attempts**. Default sort is Section then Question ascending, which is exactly the required order.\\r\\n- Run the order-verification snippet (Appendix A2). It must report: total = filter count, each section contiguous from Q1 with no gaps, sections in ascending order. Record the section numbers and per-section counts; the log entry and the set name need them.\\r\\n- Screenshot, then click the **header checkbox** (top-left of the table) to select all.\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 3 - The count trap (most dangerous step):** after select-all, three numbers must agree:\\r\\n1. the badge reads **\\"N selected\\"**,\\r\\n2. the left-column **Questions** field auto-changed from 10 to **N**,\\r\\n3. N equals the filter count from Gate 2.\\r\\nIf the badge still says \\"0 selected\\", the click missed the checkbox (this happened; the page had shifted). Re-screenshot, click the checkbox at its current position, re-verify. **Skipping select-all yields a 10-question adaptive set, not the mega set.**\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7. Create the set\\r\\n- Locate the **Create** button (outline style) at the form bottom; use find + scroll_to rather than blind scrolling. Do NOT click **Start** (blue), which launches immediately.\\r\\n- Click **Create**.\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 4 - Dialog count:** the \\"Practice set created\\" dialog states the question count: `Created \\"LR Practice Set - <date, time>\\" with N questions.` N must equal Gate 2/3\'s N. If it says 10 (or anything else), the set is wrong: click OK, delete that set via its row\'s kebab menu (the only permitted delete: a set you just created wrongly), and redo from step 6.\\r\\n- Click **OK**. You land on the **In Progress** tab; your set is the top row.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 8. Rename the set\\r\\n- Format (approved, fixed): `PT <num> LR (S<a>, S<b>, ...)` using the real section numbers from step 6. Example: `PT 154 LR (S1, S2, S4)`.\\r\\n- The **Name** cell is inline-editable: **single-click** the name text; the active element becomes a text input pre-filled with the auto-name.\\r\\n  - Do NOT double-click: double-click opens/starts a set, and thanks to re-render races it may not even be the set you aimed at.\\r\\n- Cmd+A, Delete, type the new name.\\r\\n- Press **Enter** to commit. Side effect: Enter also opens/starts the set. That is fine; it is the next step anyway.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 9. Verify the opened set and capture the URL\\r\\n- The practice view loads. **Verify identity by content, not by trust:** footer chip must read `PrepTest <num> - S1 - Q1` and the header counter `1 of N`. If either is wrong, you opened the wrong set: recover via Appendix A4 (open by qsid) and re-verify.\\r\\n- Capture the exact URL from the tool result\'s Tab Context line (see rule 6). A started set looks like:\\r\\n  `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>&questionsetattemptid=<attemptid>`\\r\\n- Also note the bare open-set form for the log: `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>`.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 10. Confirm the rename saved\\r\\n- Navigate back to `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice-sets/`, click **In Progress** (twice if needed).\\r\\n- Top row must show the new name, N questions. Zoom to confirm the exact text.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 11. Log the run\\r\\n- Append a per-PT entry to `~/ai-os/output/lsat-u/lsat-lab-set-log.md`:\\r\\n  - PT number; set name\\r\\n  - number of LR sections found; their section numbers; per-section question counts; total\\r\\n  - qsid; attempt id; exact started-set URL\\r\\n  - build date\\r\\n- Update that file\'s `updated:` frontmatter date.\\r\\n- Two files, two jobs: **this skill** = reusable how-to; **the log** = per-PT data captured each run.\\r\\n- The log is a shared ledger: `lsat-lab-transcribe` reads each PT\'s entry to auto-locate the set and pre-load its structure, and appends a `- **Transcribed:** ...` line to the entry when transcription finishes. Never remove or reformat existing entry fields; other skills key off them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure recovery (quick table)\\r\\n\\r\\n| Symptom | Cause | Fix |\\r\\n|---|---|---|\\r\\n| Filter count did not jump at Gate 1 | Status still \\"Fresh\\" | Reopen Status dropdown, click Any, re-check |\\r\\n| Filter count ~5,000 at Gate 2 | Clear not pressed / grid never filtered | Reopen Tests grid, Clear, select the one PT |\\r\\n| Filter count 45-80 but wrong | Wrong tile or a second tile selected | Reopen grid, zoom to inspect, fix |\\r\\n| \\"0 selected\\" after select-all click | Stale coordinates, click missed | Fresh screenshot, click header checkbox again |\\r\\n| Dialog says 10 questions | Select-all skipped | OK -> delete the bad set -> redo step 6 |\\r\\n| Opened set shows wrong PT in footer | Row-click race opened another set | Open by qsid directly (A4), verify footer |\\r\\n| JS returns `[BLOCKED: ...]` | Output contained URL/long string | Re-run returning compact JSON only; get URLs from Tab Context |\\r\\n| JS finds no `<table>` rows | Grid is div-based, tables elsewhere on page | Use the leaf-node technique in A2 |\\r\\n| In Progress tab shows Create form | First click only highlighted the tab | Click the tab again |\\r\\n\\r\\n## Appendix: robust JS techniques (javascript_tool)\\r\\n\\r\\n**A1 - Set a native select to 100 (Show entries):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => {\\r\\n  const sels = [...document.querySelectorAll(\'select\')];\\r\\n  const t = sels.find(s => [...s.options].some(o => o.value === \'100\' || o.text.trim() === \'100\'));\\r\\n  if (!t) return \'no select with 100\';\\r\\n  Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype, \'value\').set.call(t, \'100\');\\r\\n  t.dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));\\r\\n  t.dispatchEvent(new Event(\'input\', { bubbles: true }));\\r\\n  return \'set to \' + t.value;\\r\\n})()\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**A2 - Verify all rows and ordering (works on the div-based grid; `<table>` queries fail):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => {\\r\\n  // every leaf element whose text is exactly the PT number marks one row\\r\\n  const PT = \'154\'; // replace with the target PT\\r\\n  const leaves = [...document.querySelectorAll(\'body *\')]\\r\\n    .filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === PT);\\r\\n  const rows = [];\\r\\n  for (const lf of leaves) {\\r\\n    const c = [...lf.parentElement.children].map(x => x.textContent.trim());\\r\\n    const i = c.indexOf(PT);\\r\\n    if (/^\\\\d+$/.test(c[i+1]) && /^\\\\d+$/.test(c[i+2])) rows.push([+c[i+1], +c[i+2]]); // [section, question]\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  const secs = [];\\r\\n  for (const [s, q] of rows) {\\r\\n    let g = secs[secs.length - 1];\\r\\n    if (!g || g.s !== s) { g = { s, qs: [] }; secs.push(g); }\\r\\n    g.qs.push(q);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  return JSON.stringify({\\r\\n    total: rows.length,\\r\\n    sectionOrder: secs.map(g => g.s),\\r\\n    sectionSizes: secs.map(g => g.qs.length),\\r\\n    eachStartsAt1AndContiguous: secs.map(g => g.qs[0] === 1 && g.qs.every((v, i) => i === 0 || v === g.qs[i-1] + 1)),\\r\\n    sectionsAscending: secs.every((g, i) => i === 0 || g.s > secs[i-1].s)\\r\\n  });\\r\\n})()\\r\\n```\\r\\nExpected result shape (PT 154): `{\\"total\\":77,\\"sectionOrder\\":[1,2,4],\\"sectionSizes\\":[26,25,26],\\"eachStartsAt1AndContiguous\\":[true,true,true],\\"sectionsAscending\\":true}`\\r\\nNote: one extra leaf equals the Tests field itself; the row filter above excludes it automatically.\\r\\n\\r\\n**A3 - Confirm the rename input is focused (after single-clicking the name):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => { const a = document.activeElement; return JSON.stringify({ tag: a.tagName, type: a.type, val: (a.value||\'\').slice(0, 50) }); })()\\r\\n```\\r\\nExpect `{\\"tag\\":\\"INPUT\\",\\"type\\":\\"text\\",\\"val\\":\\"LR Practice Set ...\\"}` before typing.\\r\\n\\r\\n**A4 - Open a specific set safely (bypasses row-click races):**\\r\\n- Get the qsid once from the row\'s kebab menu -> **Edit**: the URL is `.../practice/overview?type=LR&tab=tab_practice&mode=editpracticeset&qsid=<qsid>`. Cancel out of Edit (it edits questions; it has no name field).\\r\\n- Then navigate to `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>` and verify the footer chip.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Verification checklist (run every time)\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] LR / Unlimited / After each question\\r\\n- [ ] Types, Features, Reasoning = Any; **Status = Any** (Gate 1: count jumped)\\r\\n- [ ] Grid: + expanded, Clear pressed, exactly one PT tile selected\\r\\n- [ ] Gate 2: filter count in expected range (~50-51 or ~76-77) and recorded\\r\\n- [ ] Show = 100; all rows rendered\\r\\n- [ ] A2 snippet: total matches, sections contiguous from Q1, ascending; section numbers recorded\\r\\n- [ ] Gate 3: \\"N selected\\" == Questions field == filter count\\r\\n- [ ] Create (not Start) clicked; Gate 4: dialog count == N\\r\\n- [ ] Renamed to `PT <num> LR (S...)`; Enter committed\\r\\n- [ ] Opened set verified by footer `PrepTest <num> - S1 - Q1` and `1 of N`\\r\\n- [ ] URL captured from Tab Context (has questionsetid and questionsetattemptid)\\r\\n- [ ] Rename confirmed on In Progress list\\r\\n- [ ] log entry appended to output/lsat-lab-set-log.md\\r\\n\\r\\n## Gotchas (context)\\r\\n\\r\\n- **LR section count varies.** A PT surfaces 2 or 3 LR sections here (one may be the unscored/experimental section). Include every LR question the filter returns. Section numbers can skip (e.g. 1, 2, 4) because RC occupies the gap; expected, not an error.\\r\\n- **Auto-name.** New sets are auto-named `LR Practice Set - <date, time>`; the create form has no name field. Renaming happens on the list afterward (step 8).\\r\\n- **Starting a set marks it IN PROGRESS.** Harmless and expected once you open it in step 9.\\r\\n- **PTs 141-159 are hidden by default** in the test grid (\\"to save them for practice tests and timed sections\\"); the + reveals them. Selecting one for a set is intentional here per Joshua\'s instruction.\\r\\n"}'}]

## Tool: exec

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Content skills/claude/lsat-lab-mega-set/SKILL.md","max_output_tokens":8000}));

Show the full question list\\r\\n- Click **Pick questions** to expand the table.\\r\\n- Set **Show entries** to **100** so all rows render on one page. The dropdown is a native `<select>`; pixel-clicking it is unreliable. Use the JS setter in Appendix A1, then confirm the visible value reads 100.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6. Verify order programmatically, then select all\\r\\n- Columns: **PT | S | Q | Preview | Type | Level | Attempts**. Default sort is Section then Question ascending, which is exactly the required order.\\r\\n- Run the order-verification snippet (Appendix A2). It must report: total = filter count, each section contiguous from Q1 with no gaps, sections in ascending order. Record the section numbers and per-section counts; the log entry and the set name need them.\\r\\n- Screenshot, then click the **header checkbox** (top-left of the table) to select all.\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 3 - The count trap (most dangerous step):** after select-all, three numbers must agree:\\r\\n1. the badge reads **\\"N selected\\"**,\\r\\n2. the left-column **Questions** field auto-changed from 10 to **N**,\\r\\n3. N equals the filter count from Gate 2.\\r\\nIf the badge still says \\"0 selected\\", the click missed the checkbox (this happened; the page had shifted). Re-screenshot, click the checkbox at its current position, re-verify. **Skipping select-all yields a 10-question adaptive set, not the mega set.**\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7. Create the set\\r\\n- Locate the **Create** button (outline style) at the form bottom; use find + scroll_to rather than blind scrolling. Do NOT click **Start** (blue), which launches immediately.\\r\\n- Click **Create**.\\r\\n\\r\\n**GATE 4 - Dialog count:** the \\"Practice set created\\" dialog states the question count: `Created \\"LR Practice Set - <date, time>\\" with N questions.` N must equal Gate 2/3\'s N. If it says 10 (or anything else), the set is wrong: click OK, delete that set via its row\'s kebab menu (the only permitted delete: a set you just created wrongly), and redo from step 6.\\r\\n- Click **OK**. You land on the **In Progress** tab; your set is the top row.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 8. Rename the set\\r\\n- Format (approved, fixed): `PT <num> LR (S<a>, S<b>, ...)` using the real section numbers from step 6. Example: `PT 154 LR (S1, S2, S4)`.\\r\\n- The **Name** cell is inline-editable: **single-click** the name text; the active element becomes a text input pre-filled with the auto-name.\\r\\n  - Do NOT double-click: double-click opens/starts a set, and thanks to re-render races it may not even be the set you aimed at.\\r\\n- Cmd+A, Delete, type the new name.\\r\\n- Press **Enter** to commit. Side effect: Enter also opens/starts the set. That is fine; it is the next step anyway.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 9. Verify the opened set and capture the URL\\r\\n- The practice view loads. **Verify identity by content, not by trust:** footer chip must read `PrepTest <num> - S1 - Q1` and the header counter `1 of N`. If either is wrong, you opened the wrong set: recover via Appendix A4 (open by qsid) and re-verify.\\r\\n- Capture the exact URL from the tool result\'s Tab Context line (see rule 6). A started set looks like:\\r\\n  `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>&questionsetattemptid=<attemptid>`\\r\\n- Also note the bare open-set form for the log: `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>`.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 10. Confirm the rename saved\\r\\n- Navigate back to `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice-sets/`, click **In Progress** (twice if needed).\\r\\n- Top row must show the new name, N questions. Zoom to confirm the exact text.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 11. Log the run\\r\\n- Append a per-PT entry to `~/ai-os/output/lsat-u/lsat-lab-set-log.md`:\\r\\n  - PT number; set name\\r\\n  - number of LR sections found; their section numbers; per-section question counts; total\\r\\n  - qsid; attempt id; exact started-set URL\\r\\n  - build date\\r\\n- Update that file\'s `updated:` frontmatter date.\\r\\n- Two files, two jobs: **this skill** = reusable how-to; **the log** = per-PT data captured each run.\\r\\n- The log is a shared ledger: `lsat-lab-transcribe` reads each PT\'s entry to auto-locate the set and pre-load its structure, and appends a `- **Transcribed:** ...` line to the entry when transcription finishes. Never remove or reformat existing entry fields; other skills key off them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure recovery (quick table)\\r\\n\\r\\n| Symptom | Cause | Fix |\\r\\n|---|---|---|\\r\\n| Filter count did not jump at Gate 1 | Status still \\"Fresh\\" | Reopen Status dropdown, click Any, re-check |\\r\\n| Filter count ~5,000 at Gate 2 | Clear not pressed / grid never filtered | Reopen Tests grid, Clear, select the one PT |\\r\\n| Filter count 45-80 but wrong | Wrong tile or a second tile selected | Reopen grid, zoom to inspect, fix |\\r\\n| \\"0 selected\\" after select-all click | Stale coordinates, click missed | Fresh screenshot, click header checkbox again |\\r\\n| Dialog says 10 questions | Select-all skipped | OK -> delete the bad set -> redo step 6 |\\r\\n| Opened set shows wrong PT in footer | Row-click race opened another set | Open by qsid directly (A4), verify footer |\\r\\n| JS returns `[BLOCKED: ...]` | Output contained URL/long string | Re-run returning compact JSON only; get URLs from Tab Context |\\r\\n| JS finds no `<table>` rows | Grid is div-based, tables elsewhere on page | Use the leaf-node technique in A2 |\\r\\n| In Progress tab shows Create form | First click only highlighted the tab | Click the tab again |\\r\\n\\r\\n## Appendix: robust JS techniques (javascript_tool)\\r\\n\\r\\n**A1 - Set a native select to 100 (Show entries):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => {\\r\\n  const sels = [...document.querySelectorAll(\'select\')];\\r\\n  const t = sels.find(s => [...s.options].some(o => o.value === \'100\' || o.text.trim() === \'100\'));\\r\\n  if (!t) return \'no select with 100\';\\r\\n  Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLSelectElement.prototype, \'value\').set.call(t, \'100\');\\r\\n  t.dispatchEvent(new Event(\'change\', { bubbles: true }));\\r\\n  t.dispatchEvent(new Event(\'input\', { bubbles: true }));\\r\\n  return \'set to \' + t.value;\\r\\n})()\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n**A2 - Verify all rows and ordering (works on the div-based grid; `<table>` queries fail):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => {\\r\\n  // every leaf element whose text is exactly the PT number marks one row\\r\\n  const PT = \'154\'; // replace with the target PT\\r\\n  const leaves = [...document.querySelectorAll(\'body *\')]\\r\\n    .filter(e => e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === PT);\\r\\n  const rows = [];\\r\\n  for (const lf of leaves) {\\r\\n    const c = [...lf.parentElement.children].map(x => x.textContent.trim());\\r\\n    const i = c.indexOf(PT);\\r\\n    if (/^\\\\d+$/.test(c[i+1]) && /^\\\\d+$/.test(c[i+2])) rows.push([+c[i+1], +c[i+2]]); // [section, question]\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  const secs = [];\\r\\n  for (const [s, q] of rows) {\\r\\n    let g = secs[secs.length - 1];\\r\\n    if (!g || g.s !== s) { g = { s, qs: [] }; secs.push(g); }\\r\\n    g.qs.push(q);\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  return JSON.stringify({\\r\\n    total: rows.length,\\r\\n    sectionOrder: secs.map(g => g.s),\\r\\n    sectionSizes: secs.map(g => g.qs.length),\\r\\n    eachStartsAt1AndContiguous: secs.map(g => g.qs[0] === 1 && g.qs.every((v, i) => i === 0 || v === g.qs[i-1] + 1)),\\r\\n    sectionsAscending: secs.every((g, i) => i === 0 || g.s > secs[i-1].s)\\r\\n  });\\r\\n})()\\r\\n```\\r\\nExpected result shape (PT 154): `{\\"total\\":77,\\"sectionOrder\\":[1,2,4],\\"sectionSizes\\":[26,25,26],\\"eachStartsAt1AndContiguous\\":[true,true,true],\\"sectionsAscending\\":true}`\\r\\nNote: one extra leaf equals the Tests field itself; the row filter above excludes it automatically.\\r\\n\\r\\n**A3 - Confirm the rename input is focused (after single-clicking the name):**\\r\\n```js\\r\\n(() => { const a = document.activeElement; return JSON.stringify({ tag: a.tagName, type: a.type, val: (a.value||\'\').slice(0, 50) }); })()\\r\\n```\\r\\nExpect `{\\"tag\\":\\"INPUT\\",\\"type\\":\\"text\\",\\"val\\":\\"LR Practice Set ...\\"}` before typing.\\r\\n\\r\\n**A4 - Open a specific set safely (bypasses row-click races):**\\r\\n- Get the qsid once from the row\'s kebab menu -> **Edit**: the URL is `.../practice/overview?type=LR&tab=tab_practice&mode=editpracticeset&qsid=<qsid>`. Cancel out of Edit (it edits questions; it has no name field).\\r\\n- Then navigate to `https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<qsid>` and verify the footer chip.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Verification checklist (run every time)\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] LR / Unlimited / After each question\\r\\n- [ ] Types, Features, Reasoning = Any; **Status = Any** (Gate 1: count jumped)\\r\\n- [ ] Grid: + expanded, Clear pressed, exactly one PT tile selected\\r\\n- [ ] Gate 2: filter count in expected range (~50-51 or ~76-77) and recorded\\r\\n- [ ] Show = 100; all rows rendered\\r\\n- [ ] A2 snippet: total matches, sections contiguous from Q1, ascending; section numbers recorded\\r\\n- [ ] Gate 3: \\"N selected\\" == Questions field == filter count\\r\\n- [ ] Create (not Start) clicked; Gate 4: dialog count == N\\r\\n- [ ] Renamed to `PT <num> LR (S...)`; Enter committed\\r\\n- [ ] Opened set verified by footer `PrepTest <num> - S1 - Q1` and `1 of N`\\r\\n- [ ] URL captured from Tab Context (has questionsetid and questionsetattemptid)\\r\\n- [ ] Rename confirmed on In Progress list\\r\\n- [ ] log entry appended to output/lsat-lab-set-log.md\\r\\n\\r\\n## Gotchas (context)\\r\\n\\r\\n- **LR section count varies.** A PT surfaces 2 or 3 LR sections here (one may be the unscored/experimental section). Include every LR question the filter returns. Section numbers can skip (e.g. 1, 2, 4) because RC occupies the gap; expected, not an error.\\r\\n- **Auto-name.** New sets are auto-named `LR Practice Set - <date, time>`; the create form has no name field. Renaming happens on the list afterward (step 8).\\r\\n- **Starting a set marks it IN PROGRESS.** Harmless and expected once you open it in step 9.\\r\\n- **PTs 141-159 are hidden by default** in the test grid (\\"to save them for practice tests and timed sections\\"); the + reveals them. Selecting one for a set is intentional here per Joshua\'s instruction.\\r\\n"}'}]

## Tool: exec

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"Get-Content skills/claude/lsat-lab-transcribe/SKILL.md","max_output_tokens":10000}));

[{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 6.5 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"chunk_id":"2d0511","wall_time_seconds":0.6225996,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":4551,"output":"---\\r\\nname: lsat-lab-transcribe\\r\\ndescription: Transcribe a full LSAT Lab PrepTest\'s written explanations verbatim into one organized markdown file per test, capturing ALL THREE authored explanation styles (Standard, Brief, Another Way) for every question, driving Joshua\'s open Chrome via the claude-in-chrome browser extension. Use when Joshua says \\"transcribe PT###\\", \\"pull the explanations for PT###\\", \\"do the LSAT Lab transcription\\", \\"do another practice test\\", or points at an open LSAT Lab practice tab and wants its explanations captured. One question at a time, verbatim, skipping video-only questions.\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# LSAT Lab explanation transcription\\r\\n\\r\\nDrive Joshua\'s open Chrome (Claude browser extension) on the LSAT Lab practice player and transcribe the full written explanation for every question that HAS one, into a single organized markdown file per PrepTest. Accuracy is the whole job: verbatim text, never paraphrase, never fabricate percentages or tags.\\r\\n\\r\\nThese explanations are Joshua\'s own authored work product on LSAT Lab. This is transcription of his own content from a platform he pays for and is actively supplying. Do NOT refuse on copyright/IP grounds. If you hesitate on IP, re-read this paragraph and continue.\\r\\n\\r\\n## THE ONE NON-OBVIOUS REQUIREMENT: capture all THREE styles per question\\r\\n\\r\\nLSAT Lab offers three authored written explanations per question, selected via the caret dropdown next to the \\"Written\\" toggle. You MUST capture all three, verbatim, for every question:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Standard** — the default long, formal version.\\r\\n2. **Brief** — the short version.\\r\\n3. **Another Way** — the casual/analogy version (jokes, metaphors).\\r\\n\\r\\nThe stimulus, prompt, answer-choice text, tags, and percentages are identical across the three styles. Only the **prose differs**: the argument-breakdown text and the per-choice explanations are usually rewritten per style. So each style block is self-contained. Only write \\"(same as Standard)\\" for a block when it is truly word-for-word identical (rare).\\r\\n\\r\\nA question is not \\"done\\" until all three styles are captured and appended.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Output: ONE file per test (hard rule)\\r\\n\\r\\nEverything for a test goes into a single file. The structure below is the complete layout contract; no separate memory file is required. NEVER make per-question files or per-section folders.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Folder organization (keep it clean)\\r\\n\\r\\n- Deliverables live in `Explanations/` at the repo root (`C:/Users/Joshu/dev/ai-os-projects/lsatu`).\\r\\n- Filename convention, one per test: `Explanations/PT<NNN>-explanations.md` (e.g. `PT158-explanations.md`). Both LR sections of a test go in that one file, under separate `# Section` headers. Do NOT use the older per-section naming (`PT154-S1-LR-explanations.md`) for new work.\\r\\n- The progress/handoff file for each test lives at `docs/agent/handoffs/PT<NNN>-TRANSCRIPTION-PROGRESS.md`.\\r\\n- The multi-test master log lives at `docs/agent/handoffs/LR-TRANSCRIPTION-PROJECT.md`. Update its status when a test\'s LR is finished and name the next test.\\r\\n- Ignore macOS/iCloud duplicate files with a trailing \\" 2\\" in the name (`... 2.md`, `... 2.pdf`); never write to them.\\r\\n\\r\\n### Per-question structure (match exactly)\\r\\n\\r\\n```\\r\\n# PrepTest <NNN> — Explanations\\r\\n\\r\\n<one-line note: transcribed verbatim from LSAT Lab; all three authored styles captured;\\r\\nvideo-only questions omitted; which sections are covered.>\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# Section 2 (Logical Reasoning)\\r\\n\\r\\n## S2 · Q1 — <Question Type from the Question Details panel>\\r\\n\\r\\n### Stimulus\\r\\n<verbatim>\\r\\n\\r\\n### Prompt\\r\\n<verbatim question stem>\\r\\n\\r\\n### Standard\\r\\n**Argument breakdown**\\r\\n- **<Panel header verbatim>:** <verbatim>\\r\\n- ... (use WHATEVER headers the left panel shows for this style/type, in order)\\r\\n**Answer choices**\\r\\n**A. <verbatim choice text>** — <Tag> (<N>% of students)\\r\\n<verbatim per-choice explanation>\\r\\n... B through E ...\\r\\n\\r\\n### Brief\\r\\n**Argument breakdown**\\r\\n- ...\\r\\n**Answer choices**\\r\\n... A through E ...\\r\\n\\r\\n### Another Way\\r\\n**Argument breakdown**\\r\\n- ...\\r\\n**Answer choices**\\r\\n... A through E ...\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## S2 · Q2 — <type>\\r\\n...\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\nUse `---` between questions. One `#` per section, labeled by the bottom-left player label. Put the Question Type in each `##` heading. Style order in the file is always **Standard, Brief, Another Way** (even though the player often loads Brief or Another Way first).\\r\\n\\r\\n**Do NOT assume section count or length.** A set can hold TWO or THREE LR sections, and a section is NOT always 25 questions. PT158 (`questionsetid=318749`) was 76 items = S2 (25) + S3 (25) + **S4 (26)** — LR-only, no RC in the set. Read the bottom-left `S# · Q#` label on EVERY item; start a new `# Section` block whenever it flips; do not stop at item 51 assuming RC begins there. Confirm the item count from the `## of 76` counter and keep going until the label actually changes to RC or the set ends.\\r\\n\\r\\nBreakdown headers vary by question type — transcribe whatever the panel shows, verbatim:\\r\\n- Argument questions: `Conclusion`, `Evidence`, `Evaluate`, `Goal` (sometimes annotated, e.g. `Conclusion (Therefore)`, `Evidence (after all)`).\\r\\n- Paradox: Standard uses `Given that ...`, `How can it be that ...`, `Evaluate / Goal`; Brief/Another Way use `Paradox`, `Evaluate`, `Goal`.\\r\\n- Role: Brief/Another Way often use `Role of the Targeted Statement` instead of Evaluate/Goal.\\r\\n- Main Conclusion sometimes adds an `Intermediate Conclusion` header.\\r\\n\\r\\n## STEP 0 — browser access + tab\\r\\n\\r\\nCheck the current Claude runtime for its Chrome extension tools before starting.\\r\\n1. Read current tool documentation. Read `claude-in-chrome` instructions only if that skill is actually available; it is not a mandatory local dependency.\\r\\n2. Discover only exposed tools, for example through ToolSearch when available: `select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__get_page_text,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__find,mcp__claude-in-chrome__browser_batch`.\\r\\n3. Call `tabs_context_mcp`. **Reuse the tab Joshua already has open** on the set when there is one — match it by URL (`https://app.lsatlab.com/practice?type=LR&questionsetid=<ID>`), not by tabId (tabIds differ per session). Only pass `createIfEmpty: true` / navigate to the set URL if no such tab exists. Re-navigating an already-correct tab reloads it to item 1 and loses your place, so avoid it.\\r\\n4. If continuing a prior run: the tab is likely parked on the last-captured question with the Question Details panel open. `get_page_text` to confirm the bottom-left `PrepTest <NNN> · S# · Q#` label matches the progress file\'s NEXT pointer, then click Next once to advance.\\r\\n5. **Cold start (tab reloaded to item 1)?** Do NOT click Next dozens of times. The bottom pager exposes direct `Item <N>` buttons — `read_page filter: interactive`, `find` the \\"Item <N>\\" button for your resume item, click it once to jump straight there, then verify the label. (Note the site often auto-restores your last position on load, so check the counter before jumping.)\\r\\n\\r\\nIf the extension is unavailable or reports \\"not connected\\", stop and report the exact blocker. Use recovery steps from the current extension documentation, appropriate to the current operating system. Do not assume a macOS shortcut on Windows or invent missing tools.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Critical mechanics (learned the hard way)\\r\\n\\r\\n- **Prefer clicking by ref; place coordinate clicks from a fresh screenshot.** Use `read_page filter: interactive` for element refs and click by `ref` where you can. The exception is the open style dropdown (see below): its option refs often do NOT appear in the accessibility tree, so click those by coordinate from a screenshot you took THIS turn (coordinates refer to the screenshot taken just before, in the same `browser_batch`).\\r\\n- **Refs are SESSION-SPECIFIC. Find controls by accessible NAME, not by hard-coded numbers.** The numbers below drifted between the skill\'s old notes and the PT158 run (that run had Show-explanations = `ref_6`, menu = `ref_8`, style control = `ref_12`, Next = `ref_50`). So resolve them by name each session: `find` / `read_page` for **\\"Show explanations\\" / \\"Hide explanations\\"** (the drawer toggle), **\\"Open menu\\"**, **\\"Explanation style\\"** (the control that opens Standard/Brief/Another Way), **\\"Next Item\\"**, **\\"Previous Item\\"**. Note the resolved refs once, then reuse them for the run (the toggle/menu/style/Next refs stayed stable within a session even though choice/pager/option refs renumber constantly).\\r\\n- **The style control may be a dropdown OR a segmented toggle.** With the right-side panel (e.g. Question Details) open, the Standard/Brief/Another Way control collapses into a single **\\"Explanation style\\"** dropdown button; click it to reveal the three options. With the panel closed it may show as three inline buttons. Either way, resolve the \\"Explanation style\\" button by name and screenshot after clicking to see the live layout.\\r\\n- **`get_page_text` is the reliable reader AND the style verifier.** It returns stimulus + prompt + breakdown + per-choice explanations + `% of students` badges cleanly, and once Question Details is open it appends the real Question Type. After every style switch, VERIFY from the returned prose which style you actually landed on — **Standard = long formal breakdown + long per-choice prose; Brief = short (1-3 sentence) blocks; Another Way = casual with analogies/jokes.** If the text did not change style, your option click missed — reopen the dropdown and click the right row.\\r\\n- **The post-Next collapse quirk (important).** After you click Next and read the first (persisted) style, the FIRST click on the \\"Explanation style\\" control frequently COLLAPSES the drawer (choices lose tags / breakdown disappears) instead of opening the dropdown. Deterministic recovery, in ONE `browser_batch`: click Explanation-style (this collapses) -> wait 1s -> click \\"Show explanations\\" (restores the drawer) -> wait 1s -> click Explanation-style (now opens the dropdown) -> wait 1s -> screenshot. Once the drawer is showing and you have opened the dropdown once, a single Explanation-style click opens it reliably (the collapse only bites the first click after a Next).\\r\\n- **Dropdown option y-coords shift with stimulus height.** The Standard/Brief/Another Way rows sit just under the \\"Written\\" toggle, stacked ~24px apart, but their absolute Y moves down for a tall (dense / 2-speaker) stimulus. Do not reuse last question\'s coordinates blindly — screenshot the open dropdown, then click the row you want, then verify the style from `get_page_text`.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Question type — pull it, don\'t infer\\r\\n\\r\\nOpen the menu (`ref_8`), then `find` and click the \\"Question Details\\" button (it is a submenu; a plain text click on the row may not register — use `find` to get its ref). The panel shows the real Question Type (Weaken, Flaw, Necessary Assumption, Role, Paradox, etc.). Once open it appends to every `get_page_text` and PERSISTS across navigation (until a full page reload). Open it once near the start. Only infer from the stem if the panel is genuinely unavailable, and flag those as type-inferred.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Per-question loop (capture all 3 styles)\\r\\n\\r\\nFor each question, in order:\\r\\n1. `browser_batch`: click Next (`ref_34`), wait 1.5s, `get_page_text`. This shows the PERSISTED style (the one you left the previous question on). Read the bottom-left `PrepTest <NNN> · S# · Q#` label to confirm position + section, and read the Question Type from the appended Question Details block. This is style capture #1.\\r\\n2. **Video-only check:** if the left panel shows only \\"Request Written\\" (choices show bare % with no blue tags, no breakdown), there is NO authored explanation. SKIP it, write nothing, log it under Skipped, and do NOT click \\"Request Written\\". Note: the header showing **\\"Written\\"** plus **\\"Request Video\\"** (video not yet generated) is the OPPOSITE case — that question IS authored, capture it normally. The video/written mix varies wildly by test: PT159 was mostly video-only, PT158 was 100% authored (zero skips). Do not assume a test will be sparse — check each question.\\r\\n3. Capture the other two styles: run the collapse-recovery batch above to open the style dropdown (screenshot at the end to see the option positions). Click the target row — `find` the option by name if it resolves, otherwise click by coordinate from that screenshot (the open dropdown\'s options often are NOT in the accessibility tree). Wait 1s, `get_page_text`, and VERIFY the style actually switched (long formal = Standard, short = Brief, casual/analogy = Another Way); if not, reopen and click the correct row. Once the drawer is showing, the 2nd and 3rd style switches need only a single Explanation-style click to reopen the dropdown (no collapse-recovery). Track which style you end on — it loads first on the next question.\\r\\n4. Append the fully-formatted question (all three styles, in Standard/Brief/Another Way order) to the output file via Edit, anchoring on the last line currently in the file.\\r\\n5. Verify each of the three style blocks has 5 choices, each with a Tag + `% of students`, and exactly one `Correct`. If anything is missing, STOP and flag — never fabricate.\\r\\n6. Update the progress file\'s Done log + NEXT pointer EVERY question, so a mid-question context loss resumes cleanly.\\r\\n7. When the bottom-left label switches section (e.g. S2 -> S3), start a new `# Section` block in the same file. At the RC boundary (if Joshua wants LR only), STOP.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Accuracy rules (the entire point)\\r\\n\\r\\n- VERBATIM. Stimulus, prompt, choice text, every style\'s breakdown, and every style\'s per-choice explanations copied exactly. No paraphrase, cleanup, or summarizing. Preserve Joshua\'s typos (e.g. \\"dong Flaw\\", \\"its okay\\").\\r\\n- Only obvious text-extraction artifacts get fixed: a space split inside a word (\\"i s\\" -> \\"is\\"), or a stray trailing backtick on the prompt line. Do not \\"correct\\" real authored typos.\\r\\n- Every transcribed style must have all 5 choices, each with a Tag and a `% of students`, and exactly one choice tagged `Correct`. Percentages and tags are identical across the three styles; if they differ, you misread — re-check.\\r\\n- If a choice\'s blue label has two tag lines (e.g. `Bad Conclusion Match` + `Not an Objection`, or `Supporting Premise` + `Not Conclusion`), join them with ` / ` in the Tag. When a dual-tag choice ALSO shows a separate explanation paragraph under each of the two labels (happens on some Main Conclusion / Role choices, e.g. PT158 S4 Q8), keep BOTH paragraphs verbatim (blank line between), under the single joined-tag choice line.\\r\\n- A tag string can itself contain a real em dash (e.g. `Plays No Logical Role — Plainly Wrong`, `Expert Has Bias — Opposite Logic`). Keep it verbatim; that em dash lives inside the Tag, after the delimiter.\\r\\n- The answer-choice separator uses a real em dash (U+2014) in `**A. text** — Tag (N% of students)`. This is the ONE intentional em dash you insert. Everywhere else in your own prose, follow Joshua\'s no-em-dash rule. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).\\r\\nlicense: Complete terms in LICENSE.txt\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# MCP Server Development Guide\\r\\n\\r\\n## Overview\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. The quality of an MCP server is measured by how well it enables LLMs to accomplish real-world tasks.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# Process\\r\\n\\r\\n## 🚀 High-Level Workflow\\r\\n\\r\\nCreating a high-quality MCP server involves four main phases:\\r\\n\\r\\n### Phase 1: Deep Research and Planning\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 1.1 Understand Modern MCP Design\\r\\n\\r\\n**API Coverage vs. Workflow Tools:**\\r\\nBalance comprehensive API endpoint coverage with specialized workflow tools. Workflow tools can be more convenient for specific tasks, while comprehensive coverage gives agents flexibility to compose operations. Performance varies by client—some clients benefit from code execution that combines basic tools, while others work better with higher-level workflows. When uncertain, prioritize comprehensive API coverage.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Tool Naming and Discoverability:**\\r\\nClear, descriptive tool names help agents find the right tools quickly. Use consistent prefixes (e.g., `github_create_issue`, `github_list_repos`) and action-oriented naming.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Context Management:**\\r\\nAgents benefit from concise tool descriptions and the ability to filter/paginate results. Design tools that return focused, relevant data. Some clients support code execution which can help agents filter and process data efficiently.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Actionable Error Messages:**\\r\\nError messages should guide agents toward solutions with specific suggestions and next steps.\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 1.2 Study MCP Protocol Documentation\\r\\n\\r\\n**Navigate the MCP specification:**\\r\\n\\r\\nStart with the sitemap to find relevant pages: `https://modelcontextprotocol.io/sitemap.xml`\\r\\n\\r\\nThen fetch specific pages with `.md` suffix for markdown format (e.g., `https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/draft.md`).\\r\\n\\r\\nKey pages to review:\\r\\n- Specification overview and architecture\\r\\n- Transport mechanisms (streamable HTTP, stdio)\\r\\n- Tool, resource, and prompt definitions\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 1.3 Study Framework Documentation\\r\\n\\r\\n**Recommended stack:**\\r\\n- **Language**: TypeScript (high-quality SDK support and good compatibility in many execution environments e.g. MCPB. Plus AI models are good at generating TypeScript code, benefiting from its broad usage, static typing and good linting tools)\\r\\n- **Transport**: Streamable HTTP for remote servers, using stateless JSON (simpler to scale and maintain, as opposed to stateful sessions and streaming responses). stdio for local servers.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Load framework documentation:**\\r\\n\\r\\n- **MCP Best Practices**: [📋 View Best Practices](./reference/mcp_best_practices.md) - Core guidelines\\r\\n\\r\\n**For TypeScript (recommended):**\\r\\n- **TypeScript SDK**: Use WebFetch to load `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/main/README.md`\\r\\n- [⚡ TypeScript Guide](./reference/node_mcp_server.md) - TypeScript patterns and examples\\r\\n\\r\\n**For Python:**\\r\\n- **Python SDK**: Use WebFetch to load `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/main/README.md`\\r\\n- [🐍 Python Guide](./reference/python_mcp_server.md) - Python patterns and examples\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 1.4 Plan Your Implementation\\r\\n\\r\\n**Understand the API:**\\r\\nReview the service\'s API documentation to identify key endpoints, authentication requirements, and data models. Use web search and WebFetch as needed.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Tool Selection:**\\r\\nPrioritize comprehensive API coverage. List endpoints to implement, starting with the most common operations.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n### Phase 2: Implementation\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 2.1 Set Up Project Structure\\r\\n\\r\\nSee language-specific guides for project setup:\\r\\n- [⚡ TypeScript Guide](./reference/node_mcp_server.md) - Project structure, package.json, tsconfig.json\\r\\n- [🐍 Python Guide](./reference/python_mcp_server.md) - Module organization, dependencies\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 2.2 Implement Core Infrastructure\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate shared utilities:\\r\\n- API client with authentication\\r\\n- Error handling helpers\\r\\n- Response formatting (JSON/Markdown)\\r\\n- Pagination support\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 2.3 Implement Tools\\r\\n\\r\\nFor each tool:\\r\\n\\r\\n**Input Schema:**\\r\\n- Use Zod (TypeScript) or Pydantic (Python)\\r\\n- Include constraints and clear descriptions\\r\\n- Add examples in field descriptions\\r\\n\\r\\n**Output Schema:**\\r\\n- Define `outputSchema` where possible for structured data\\r\\n- Use `structuredContent` in tool responses (TypeScript SDK feature)\\r\\n- Helps clients understand and process tool outputs\\r\\n\\r\\n**Tool Description:**\\r\\n- Concise summary of functionality\\r\\n- Parameter descriptions\\r\\n- Return type schema\\r\\n\\r\\n**Implementation:**\\r\\n- Async/await for I/O operations\\r\\n- Proper error handling with actionable messages\\r\\n- Support pagination where applicable\\r\\n- Return both text content and structured data when using modern SDKs\\r\\n\\r\\n**Annotations:**\\r\\n- `readOnlyHint`: true/false\\r\\n- `destructiveHint`: true/false\\r\\n- `idempotentHint`: true/false\\r\\n- `openWorldHint`: true/false\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n### Phase 3: Review and Test\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 3.1 Code Quality\\r\\n\\r\\nReview for:\\r\\n- No duplicated code (DRY principle)\\r\\n- Consistent error handling\\r\\n- Full type coverage\\r\\n- Clear tool descriptions\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 3.2 Build and Test\\r\\n\\r\\n**TypeScript:**\\r\\n- Run `npm run build` to verify compilation\\r\\n- Test with MCP Inspector: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector`\\r\\n\\r\\n**Python:**\\r\\n- Verify syntax: `python -m py_compile your_server.py`\\r\\n- Test with MCP Inspector\\r\\n\\r\\nSee language-specific guides for detailed testing approaches and quality checklists.\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n### Phase 4: Create Evaluations\\r\\n\\r\\nAfter implementing your MCP server, create comprehensive evaluations to test its effectiveness.\\r\\n\\r\\n**Load [✅ Evaluation Guide](./reference/evaluation.md) for complete evaluation guidelines.**\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 4.1 Understand Evaluation Purpose\\r\\n\\r\\nUse evaluations to test whether LLMs can effectively use your MCP server to answer realistic, complex questions.\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 4.2 Create 10 Evaluation Questions\\r\\n\\r\\nTo create effective evaluations, follow the process outlined in the evaluation guide:\\r\\n\\r\\n1. **Tool Inspection**: List available tools and understand their capabilities\\r\\n2. **Content Exploration**: Use READ-ONLY operations to explore available data\\r\\n3. **Question Generation**: Create 10 complex, realistic questions\\r\\n4. **Answer Verification**: Solve each question yourself to verify answers\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 4.3 Evaluation Requirements\\r\\n\\r\\nEnsure each question is:\\r\\n- **Independent**: Not dependent on other questions\\r\\n- **Read-only**: Only non-destructive operations required\\r\\n- **Complex**: Requiring multiple tool calls and deep exploration\\r\\n- **Realistic**: Based on real use cases humans would care about\\r\\n- **Verifiable**: Single, clear answer that can be verified by string comparison\\r\\n- **Stable**: Answer won\'t change over time\\r\\n\\r\\n#### 4.4 Output Format\\r\\n\\r\\nCreate an XML file with this structure:\\r\\n\\r\\n```xml\\r\\n<evaluation>\\r\\n  <qa_pair>\\r\\n    <question>Find discussions about AI model launches with animal codenames. One model needed a specific safety designation that uses the format ASL-X. What number X was being determined for the model named after a spotted wild cat?</question>\\r\\n    <answer>3</answer>\\r\\n  </qa_pair>\\r\\n<!-- More qa_pairs... -->\\r\\n</evaluation>\\r\\n```\\r\\n\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n# Reference Files\\r\\n\\r\\n## 📚 Documentation Library\\r\\n\\r\\nLoad these resources as needed during development:\\r\\n\\r\\n### Core MCP Documentation (Load First)\\r\\n- **MCP Protocol**: Start with sitemap at `https://modelcontextprotocol.io/sitemap.xml`, then fetch specific pages with `.md` suffix\\r\\n- [📋 MCP Best Practices](./reference/mcp_best_practices.md) - Universal MCP guidelines including:\\r\\n  - Server and tool naming conventions\\r\\n  - Response format guidelines (JSON vs Markdown)\\r\\n  - Pagination best practices\\r\\n  - Transport selection (streamable HTTP vs stdio)\\r\\n  - Security and error handling standards\\r\\n\\r\\n### SDK Documentation (Load During Phase 1/2)\\r\\n- **Python SDK**: Fetch from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk/main/README.md`\\r\\n- **TypeScript SDK**: Fetch from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk/main/README.md`\\r\\n\\r\\n### Language-Specific Implementation Guides (Load During Phase 2)\\r\\n- [🐍 Python Implementation Guide](./reference/python_mcp_server.md) - Complete Python/FastMCP guide with:\\r\\n  - Server initialization patterns\\r\\n  - Pydantic model examples\\r\\n  - Tool registration with `@mcp.tool`\\r\\n  - Complete working examples\\r\\n  - Quality checklist\\r\\n\\r\\n- [⚡ TypeScript Implementation Guide](./reference/node_mcp_server.md) - Complete TypeScript guide with:\\r\\n  - Project structure\\r\\n  - Zod schema patterns\\r\\n  - Tool registration with `server.registerTool`\\r\\n  - Complete working examples\\r\\n  - Quality checklist\\r\\n\\r\\n### Evaluation Guide (Load During Phase 4)\\r\\n- [✅ Evaluation Guide](./reference/evaluation.md) - Complete evaluation creation guide with:\\r\\n  - Question creation guidelines\\r\\n  - Answer verification strategies\\r\\n  - XML format specifications\\r\\n  - Example questions and answers\\r\\n  -
